title: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs: RREP seq_num mismatch causes route discovery validation failure
description: Line 579: RREP is generated with `seq_num: own_seq` (destination's sequence number), but RouteDiscovery::receive_rrep at line 288 validates `rrep.seq_num != self.seq_num` (expects RREQ's sequence number). These are different values. When node A sends RREQ(seq=100) to find B, node B generates RREP(seq=50 using own_seq). Node A receives RREP and checks seq==100, but gets 50, causing InvalidDiscoveryReply error. Either line 579 should use `rreq.seq_num` for correlation, or line 288 should not compare seq_num.
close_reason: Fixed seq_num mismatch: removed incorrect seq_num validation from RouteDiscovery::receive_rrep. LOADng RREP carries destination's seq_num (route freshness), not RREQ's seq_num (duplicate detection). Correlation is via (originator, destination) addresses. Updated test to use different seq_nums, verifying correct protocol behavior.
